analogy.rationale: SSRIs block SLC6A4 with weak off-target monoamine/GPCR activity, and these cells express little SLC6A4, so the transcriptional response should be weak; the closest analogs are other monoamine-transporter/reuptake inhibitors and antidepressants that share the same limited downstream monoamine signaling.
